question: Combining the s042 cohort scaling rule with s032 per-seed bracket coverage, what is the cohort cell-count cost of an |omega|-aware adaptive bracket, and does the current bracket cover the basin?
hypothesis: The current uniform bracket cannot satisfy both ends of the cohort |omega| distribution; a per-seed adaptive bracket conditioned on an LS-peak prior is much cheaper than a cohort-shared grid.
narrative_md: Pure-math projection on cached data: under the conservative c=1%/a=0.5 scaling rule the current s032 bracket covers basin on 0/78 OK seeds, because 5% is ~2x the median required basin width post-fix. Per-seed adaptive bracket conditioned on a +/-10-50% LS-peak prior costs 1.7-8.5k cohort cells, 1.4-14x cheaper than a 23.9k shared grid. Reads cohort truth |omega| values as input.
